subject: Renewal: Dedicated GPU expansion & throughput SLO addendum
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rajan <priya.rajan@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Hi Priyom,

We're starting our renewal planning and want to lock in an expansion to our Dedicated pool for Q1. Current contract covers 8xA10G-equivalent GPUs; we're targeting an additional 6 GPUs to support a new multimodal workload (image+text).

High level asks:
- Additional 6 GPUs reserved for primary pool starting 2027-01-15
- Throughput guarantee: sustained 18k tokens/sec aggregate for the pool during business hours (US PST 09:00–18:00) with a canary rollout for the first 30 days
- Billing: pro-rated for Jan and then monthly thereafter; looking for an indicative uplift so we can budget

Can you confirm feasibility and share the addendum language you typically use for tokens/sec SLOs and canary windows? Also copying our procurement (Priya) for contracting steps.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of AI Product — BluePeak Analytics
---
BluePeak Analytics | jordan.m@bluepeak.ai
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and reasonable to scope. Short answers up front: yes, we can reserve +6 GPUs and codify a tokens/sec SLO with a 30-day canary; we do recommend a short tolerance window for transient load.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will circulate a draft addendum (attached) that adds the GPU quantities, start date, and SLO section for throughput (tokens/sec) with measurement and remediation language.
2) Aditya will confirm the capacity mapping (tokens/sec to GPUs) and expected P95 latency impact for the new workload.
3) Marissa will own rollout sequencing and the pro-rated billing schedule for Jan.

I've attached a first-pass addendum (BP-Dedicated-Addendum-v1.1.pdf) and a mutual action plan (BluePeak-MAP-Nov2026.xlsx). Please review the SLO wording under Section 3 — it includes an automated fallback to a compatible model family if the pool's sustained throughput falls below 90% of the committed tokens/sec for a rolling 10-minute window.

If that fallback is acceptable to BluePeak, we can keep the standard penalty/credit model (monthly credit proportional to shortfall). If you'd prefer a stricter SLA with monetary credits starting immediately at 95% breach, flag that and we can route to contracts.

Call to action: can you confirm the start date (you listed 2027-01-15) and whether the 09:00–18:00 window should be PST only or if you'd like it applied multi-region?

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Jordan — quick technical note on sizing and tokens/sec mapping. I ran a cost / perf estimate against your multimodal baseline (image captions + long context text):
- Baseline model variant: redwood-m-7b-v2 quantized (mixed precision path)
- Observed median per-GPU sustained throughput: ~3,000 tokens/sec for the exact mix you shared in the perf trace.
- 6 additional GPUs => theoretical pool uplift ~18k tokens/sec sustained (matches your ask).

Notes and caveats:
- The 18k value assumes continuous packing and that KV cache hit rates stay > 65% (we get a large perf boost with prefix caching).
- For cold-start spikes we recommend a 5-minute autoscale buffer (pre-warming) during the first 30 days of the canary.
- P95 latency at 512-token average response should remain < 220ms with this configuration under the 18k sustained profile.

I'm attaching our throughput-runbook.pdf which describes measurement (sample interval: 15s, aggregation: rolling 1m), the exact token accounting (input+output), and how we surface breaches. Happy to hop on a short call to walk the team through the measurement math.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Jordan — operational / billing notes from my side:
- Pro-rating: Jan pro-rate will be 16 days (1/15–1/31) at the committed monthly rate for the added GPUs. We will show Jan as a separate line on your invoice and start regular monthly billing in Feb.
- Canary: we propose a 30-day canary starting 2027-01-15 with automated observability checks. If the pool fails to meet 90% of the committed throughput for > 12 hours total during the canary (non-contiguous), we'll schedule a joint review.
- Addendum language: Section 3.2 includes a remediation ladder: 1) alert and mitigation playbook, 2) temporary quota increase or burst credits, 3) credit calculation if not resolved by end of canary.

I'll prepare the billing schedule and the DocuSign envelope once we agree on final SLO terms. Attaching the MAP for sequencing; please confirm owners for each line item so we can set internal tasks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rajan <priya.rajan@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Thanks — quick counterpoints from our side:
- We prefer the SLO baseline to be a 95% sustained tokens/sec for the business hours window, with credits applying after 24 cumulative hours of shortfall across the calendar month (not just during canary).
- Canary: 30-day is fine but we'd like a 7-day early-exit if the canary metrics hit >98% of the target for 7 consecutive days.
- Remedies: instead of temporary quota increase, we'd prefer an automatic rollback to the previous model variant if latency or error rate regresses during canary; then you can either fix-forward or continue with the fallback.

Priya (procurement) — adding you for contracting cadence and DocuSign routing; can you share any internal deadlines for PO issuance?

On the SLO wording, can you add explicit measurement windows and the exact metric name (e.g., pool.tokens_per_second.rolling_1m.p95) so our SRE can wire the monitors?

Jordan
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.m@bluepeak.ai>, Priya Rajan <priya.rajan@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — dedicated pool expansion request

Jordan / Priya — great, thanks for the clarifications. We can accept the changes with two small edits:
1) SLO baseline updated to 95% sustained tokens/sec during the 09:00–18:00 business hours window (metric name to be exactly pool.tokens_per_second.rolling_1m.p95).
2) Credits will apply after 24 cumulative hours of shortfall in a billing month; during the 30-day canary credits will be held in abeyance but we will trigger automatic fallbacks as you requested if the canary shows regression.

We will update Section 3.2 in the addendum to reflect the 7-day early-exit clause and the rollback behavior you described. Aditya — please confirm the rollback signal we should expose (error rate threshold + P95 latency delta). Vivek — I'll loop you for final contract approval once Priya confirms PO timing so we can get to DocuSign.

Next steps:
- Marissa will revise the MAP and billing lines; Aditya will add the exact metric thresholds to the throughput-runbook.
- We will send a revised addendum draft by EOD Thu 2026-12-03 and a DocuSign envelope once Priya confirms the PO ETA.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in place for your Jan launch.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
